raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. As a result, v2 evening transactions (18:00-24:00 local) land at 00:00-06:00 UTC on the next date. The samples fit this: v2 rows start at about 12:00, matching legacy rows that start at about 06:00 local (UTC-6). This produces the spurious off-hours transactions and the 36 rows dated 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago so all txn_ts and txn_date values use the same local time as historical data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
